details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_priority_lane_decide (used in review sweeps and merge-train) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The starvation cap (PRIORITY_LANE_MAX_DEFER_MINUTES) is worked out again on every tick from when the current hold started, so when one priority run finishes and another starts, a new hold begins and the cap clock restarts for all non-priority PRs.
  WHY: A continuous chain of priority runs can hold non-priority PRs indefinitely, which breaks the goal "No PR is held back for longer than a cap"; the source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high. Four reviewers also raised this root cause as a task gap.
- scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:388-406 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In review_final_ci_sweep_main, a non-priority head whose gate state is unknown uses a FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK slot at line 389 before the second `_pr_priority_lane_decide` block (line 402) can defer it, so a past-cap (released) head later in the same tick can be skipped because the cap is already used up.
  WHY: This contradicts "A head the final-CI sweep holds back does not use up a FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK slot" (changelog.d/10048-priority-lane.md; scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:104-107) and delays the head by one extra tick. It is the same class of defect the last run fixed for the known-success path. The source severity was NIT, mapped here to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "No PR is held back for longer than a cap. After the cap it is dispatched as today." (Issue #10048 Goals; Approach step 4: "measured from the first skip"; risk section: "The cap bounds every deferral")
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_priority_lane_pressure` / `_pr_priority_lane_decide`, plus the hold-start state used by scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh `review_sweep_priority_lane_hold` (`priority-lane-hold.txt`), scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_priority_lane_defer_for_base` (`_MT_PRIORITY_LANE_HOLD_SINCE`) and the hold-file consumer in scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hold-start state persists between ticks. Each tick recomputes hold_since from the runs queued at that moment as the oldest qualifying run's created_at plus PRIORITY_LANE_WAIT_MINUTES/WAIT_S (the `\(.c + $wait_s)` output of `_pr_priority_lane_pressure`; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3843-3844). The "Known limit" header comment added by the last run (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3711-3716, cited by minimax as lines 3613-3616) admits the cap restarts when the oldest priority run leaves the queue while a younger one still qualifies. In the reviewers' example timelines a PR is held to t0+185m or t0+255m, beyond the cap. The change only documents the limit; no code bounds total deferral by PRIORITY_LANE_MAX_DEFER_MINUTES. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- requirement: "Create the `ai:priority` label where the pipeline creates its other labels." (Issue #10048 Approach step 5 / Implementation step 5)
  expected_change_site: scripts/label_helpers.sh `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` / `_AI_LABEL_DESCS` catalogue, together with .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/label_helpers.sh has no `ai:priority` entry in either catalogue (lines 23-91, 93-161), and no PR hunk adds one. `ensure_label_exists "ai:priority"` at scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:168 creates the label through the fallback path (scripts/label_helpers.sh:185-186), so it gets the generic colour `1d76db` and the description "AI workflow label". The work was deferred because .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json is not in the sandbox checkout and must change in the same edit. tests/test_ai_labels.py and tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py::test_label_contract_matches_helper_catalog_and_phase_priority may fail in a full-checkout CI run. All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- requirement: "skip new dispatches for non-priority PRs in that tick and log one line per skipped PR" (Issue #10048 Approach step 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh, the early priority-lane decide block (around lines 373-388) and the per-tick cap handling in `review_final_ci_sweep_main`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `&& [ "${checked}" -lt "${max}" ]` gate added by the last run means `_pr_priority_lane_decide` runs only while checked < max (lines 379-388). Once FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK is reached, later non-priority PRs are skipped with no `PRIORITY_LANE` line; before the change they got a misleading `outcome=released` line. `test_sweep_released_line_only_when_a_slot_is_left` asserts no alternative line. All three reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed this gap (cap-skipped PRs are not held by the hold, and the baseline never logged them).
- requirement: "The review sweep and the final-CI sweep (`FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`), sort candidates so priority PRs come first."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh, candidate ordering in `review_final_ci_sweep_main`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 357-360 put first only the priority candidates whose `known_gate == "success"`. A priority candidate with an unknown gate is placed after every non-priority success candidate, so a non-priority candidate can use the tick's final-CI slot first. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- (No standard findings; all categories NONE.) The reviewer checked the last run's change in scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh, lines 378-388, and found it correct: deferred heads before the cap use no slot (the continue at line 385 comes before checked is incremented), priority heads still take their slot at line 389, and fci_lane_done=true prevents a double check at lines 402-406. It rejects minimax's pass-1 deferred-logging point as not a defect.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "No PR is held back for longer than a cap. After the cap it is dispatched as today." (Issue #10048, Goals and Approach step 4: "measured from the first skip")
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, _pr_priority_lane_pressure / _pr_priority_lane_decide, and the hold-start origin passed to scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh review_sweep_priority_lane_hold and scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_priority_lane_defer_for_base.
  Evidence of absence: Every tick recomputes the hold start as the oldest qualifying run's created_at plus PRIORITY_LANE_WAIT_S (`\(.c + $wait_s)`). The hold file under RUNNER_TEMP and _MT_PRIORITY_LANE_HOLD_SINCE last for one run or process only. The "Known limit" comment admits the cap restarts. In the reviewer's example a PR is held until t0+185m, not t0+135m, and overlapping priority runs extend the hold further. Only documented, not bounded.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Issue #10048 Approach step 5 and Implementation step 5: "Create the `ai:priority` label where the pipeline creates its other labels."
  Expected change site: scripts/label_helpers.sh, the _AI_LABEL_COLORS and _AI_LABEL_DESCS catalogue (ai:security is at lines 76 and 146), together with .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json.
  Evidence of absence: There is no ai:priority key and no PR hunk adds one. scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh creates the label at run time via ensure_label_exists, so it gets the generic fallback colour and description. The contract file is absent from the checkout, so a full-checkout pass must add both together.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  Evidence of absence: `ensure_label_exists "ai:priority"` is called in `scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh`, but the `scripts/label_helpers.sh` catalogue has no matching entry.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

  Requirement: Log one line per skipped PR while the priority hold is active.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh.
  Evidence of absence: When the sweep reaches FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK, the loop breaks before `_pr_priority_lane_decide` can run, so non-priority PRs beyond the limit are skipped with no `PRIORITY_LANE` log line.
  SEVERITY: NIT
